{{Top|leg}}
'''Inpoll''' was the name of the [[Autumn/Legends|fall]] season on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. The season lasted for a quarter of [[Draenell's Point]]'s [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] cycle, spanning fourteen [[Standard month/Legends|months]] as the planet's [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was 4.2 standard years long.
